en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Bin Musa Bin Sa’adan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who takes from his moustache, and clips his nails, and washes his head with the hibiscus on the day of Friday would be like the one who emancipated a person’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Musa ibn Sa‘dan from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One who trims his fingernails and washes his head with marshmallow plant every Friday is like one who sets free one human soul from bondage and slavery.’”
